notes.title: Honour Among Thieves Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923284/2ac3ca58445c1b8f922b5689f5d00530fb107351.png[/img]

[h1]Honour Among Thieves Major Update [/h1]

The first major update for Band of Brigands is here! Featuring a new [b]quest system[/b] and new [b]powerful elite cards[/b] as a reward for completing the quests! 

Will you honour the common quest with your fellow brigands or become a sly saboteur for your own gain? The choice is yours! 


[b]Version 1.30 Changelog[/b]

[b]New Features: [/b]

- Quest System: At the beginning of each game, every brigand will have to choose a quest, that will also become active for every other fellow brigand. The progress for the completion of the quests is shared among all the brigands and upon completion, every brigand gets a powerful reward. 

- Reward Cards: A new set of unique cards have been added to the game with game changing effects! Upon completion of a quest all brigands can select one powerful unique card per quest completed. 


[b]Gameplay: [/b]

- Added coins required to win UI indicator. 

- Added an abstract visual representation of how much coins a player has gathered. 

- Hidden the value of coins that every other player has gathered by default. (This is a game option that can be turned on / off in the game options). 

[i]Design Note: We believe that this design decision will create more tension between the players and change the dynamic of the gameplay leading to more fun opportunities (acting upon incomplete information, rather than concrete decision making). This also give more opportunities for players to bluff and play the social aspect of the game more strategically. [/i]

- Reduced the transparency of the input hints to make them more discreet. 

- Discard Card mode now toggles off at the end of a players turn 


[b]Adjustments: [/b]

Invoker: 

- Telekinetic Shove AP cost reduced to 2 (was 3). 

Vagabond: 

- Javelin Throw damage increased to 1d4 + 2 (was 1d4 + 0). 

 

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]

- Fixed an issue when targeting an action over UI and click it would still let that action play through. 

- Pressing ESC during a target selection action, now correctly cancels it. 

- Pressing ESC now correctly toggles the “pause panel” on/off. 

- Fixed a few issues when exiting a game session, which will result in a more stable experience. 

- Fixed issue with invoker’s barrier SFX not being affected by SFX volume mixer. 

- Fixed issue when sometimes animations would make characters face the wrong direction. 

- Fixed issue when sometimes using a basic attack as a first action would hang the game. 

- Added timeout timer on failed to complete Feedback FX. 

- Fixed issue where the main menu buttons would be clickable before the intro sequence finished. 

- Fixed an issue where multiplayer clients would not reset their discard card limit between turns 

- Fixed issue with input hints always trying to fade in 

- Fixed an issue where an error would be thrown when exiting back to the main menu during an online session 

- Fixed an issue where during the tutorial dialogue keyboard shortcuts were active 

- Fixed issue that sometimes when a non-host client disconnects, it would cause AI behaviour to crash 

- Fixed an issue in graphic options UI that would display the wrong resolution value

notes.title: Official Steam Deck Compatibility is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923284/4eab8808a853eb1a5e48f31fa9d63001dbbae0d3.png[/img]

We're excited to announce that Band of Brigands is fully playable on the Steam Deck! Whether you're at home or on the go, you can enjoy the same great experience optimized for the Steam Deck.

What to Expect:
[list]
[*] [b] Plug'n'Play:[/b] No extra setup required, download and enjoy Band of Brigands straight away!
[*] [b]Seamless Performance:[/b] Dive into smooth gameplay with controls tailored for the Steam Deck.
[*] [b]Optimized Experience:[/b] We've ensured that the visuals and performance shine on the Deck’s hardware.
[*] [b]Native Support:[/b] Run Band of Brigands natively on SteamOS without the need for Proton.
[*] [b]Multi-Platform Multiplayer Support:[/b] Play with your fellow brigands regardless which platform they are playing from!
[*] [b]Play Anywhere:[/b] Take your adventure with you, no matter where you are!
[/list]
We're committed to ensuring Band of Brigand plays its best on Steam Deck, and we’d love to hear your feedback! If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please share them with us in the community hub or on our official [url=https://discord.gg/BsM2RJzs8U]discord channel[/url].

Happy gaming! 🎮

notes.title: Release 1.25, a few updates!
notes.content:
Featured: 
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with outro sounds not being mixed with the SFX settings  
[/list]

New Features: 
[list]
[*] Camera can now be controlled with WASD
[*] Added skip intro functionality by pressing ESC
[*] Added decrement button for the basic attacks
[*] Added contextual info for interactable to aid player decision making 
[*] Loot chest warning when hand is full 
[*] Buff Shrine when aura already active 
[*] Added camera Edge Panning (Can be disabled from settings)
[*] Added Keyboard and Mouse Input hints Fail 
[*] Upgraded dice roller animations and feedback
[*] Added new animation for characters who draw a card
[*] Added the ability for players to discard a card from their hands to gain +1 AP during their turn. (Capped at 3 times) Fail 
[*] When using Windowed mode, there are more available resolution (this will help ultra-wide screen users to force the game into more commonly used aspect ratios) 
[*] Knocking a character using the “Knockback” feature now deals damage equal to the max knock distance, if they collide with an obstacle or another character 
[/list]

Gameplay: 
[list]
[*] Slimmed player decks and basic card distribution to emphasize the class’ strengths  
[*] Re-balanced the damage output of the Tyrant to be threatening but leave opportunities for counter-play 
[/list]

Adjustments: 
[list]
[*] Rebinded keyboard shortcuts to 1,2,3... 
[*] Main Menu Lobby UI Improvements 
[*] Adjusted dialogue/tooltip text size 
[/list]

Bug Fixes: 
[list]
[*] Typo fixes for card descriptions 
[*] Fixed issue with tooltip text wrapping 
[*] Fixed issue where player incapacitated animations did not play correctly over the network	 
[*] Fixed nameplate positions to work correctly with different resolutions and aspect ratios (including ultra-wide screens!) 
[*] Fixed issue when starting an online game with 0 or negative value coins. 
[/list]

- Class icon on lobby is now clickable and navigates to class selection menu 

- Updated Solo Adventure parameters to reflect this experience better 


Bug Fixes: 

- Fixed issue with dialogue text overlapping 

- Fixed issue with an error while exiting back to main menu
